correctness.rationale: Reconstructed odd-majority polynomial h_r and its exact two-new-voter step: h_(r+1)-h_r=binom(2r+1,r)p^(r+1)(1-p)^(r+1)(2p-1). Integrating against Beta(alpha,beta) and evaluating at mu=alpha/(alpha+beta) gives the stated successive-gain ratio R_r. Its initial value s^2/((s+1)(s+2))<1; the sign of R_(r+1)/R_r-1 is controlled by F(t)=(alpha-beta)^2*t^2+[s^3-alpha*beta*(4s+6)]*t-alpha*beta*(3s+2), t=r+1. For alpha!=beta, positive leading coefficient and negative constant imply exactly one positive root and a single valley in R; asymptotic quotient s^2/(4alpha beta)>1 forces a unique crossing of 1, with a possible equality step/two adjacent maxima. The signed accuracy gap begins zero, rises then falls toward a strictly positive de Finetti/LLN limit, hence its absolute value has the same peak and remains positive. alpha=beta gives symmetry and identically zero gap. Independently recomputed 168 exact-rational majority-step comparisons including alpha,beta fractional values and the (10,1) five-juror maximizer; this is only a finite cross-check.
